chunks: Ahmad ibn al-Hasan narrated from 'Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadah from 'Ammar al-Sabati who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who forgets to say the Takbir during the days of Tashriq. He said, 'If he forgets until he rises from his place, there is nothing upon him.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a pilgrim forgets to say Takbir during the days of Tashriq?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the concept of *nasi* (forgetfulness) is distinguished from intentional omission, establishing that the pilgrim is exempt from penalty once the prayer session concludes. This ruling highlights the Shia jurisprudential principle of leniency in ritual obligations when errors are unintentional, reflecting the broader theological emphasis on divine mercy over rigid formalism in the rites of Hajj.
